narration: Your brain is doing this to you right now.
You probably believe this: YOU ESTIMATE PRICES AND NUMBERS INDEPENDENTLY. But that's not the full story.

The first number you see drags every later judgment toward it, even random ones. Here's what's happening: Your brain adjusts away from the anchor, but never adjusts far enough. Every negotiator knows this.
Kahneman: a rigged roulette wheel landed on 10, participants' guesses of African UN nations dropped by about 10 countries versus a wheel showing 65.
Before any negotiation, set YOUR anchor first, even in your head. Never let them place the first number. That's your Mindforge move for today. Follow for tomorrow's.
